name: Cistercian Abbey of Fontenay
description: Tucked into a wooded Burgundian valley near Montbard, Fontenay Abbey was founded in the early 12th century by Saint Bernard of Clairvaux and is one of Europe's oldest and most complete Cistercian monasteries. Its plain Romanesque church, cloister, dormitory and forge still stand, showing how monks lived and worked largely without outside help. The bare stone and quiet setting make it feel remarkably unchanged.
